verdict.rationale: Datalab supports background, non-blocking automation via webhooks (eliminating polling) and 'Pipelines' that chain processors into versioned, reusable configurations deployable to production, plus a 'run document agent' endpoint for published agent processors — these together allow document workflows to run unattended once triggered. However there is no evidence of scheduling, event-based triggers, or a true autonomous loop that decides when/what to run without an external caller invoking the API. Missing for 10: scheduling/cron or event-trigger mechanisms, evidence of multi-step autonomous decision-making beyond a single processor call, and independent confirmation of pipelines running unattended in production.
